summary: Examples of human_to_bytes with '1.15 GB', a bare number with default_unit G, full unit words like '2.5 gigabyte', and error cases for isbits mismatch and invalid units.
questions: Does human_to_bytes accept words like gigabyte?
Why does human_to_bytes error with isbits=true on GB?
How many bytes is 1 Gigabyte according to human_to_bytes?

answer_card.title: human_to_bytes examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
size: '{{ "1.15 GB" | human_to_bytes }}'                    # 1234803098
size: '{{ "1.15" | human_to_bytes(default_unit="G") }}'     # 1234803098
size: '{{ "2.5 gigabyte" | human_to_bytes }}'               # 2684354560
size: '{{ "1 Gigabyte" | human_to_bytes }}'                 # 1073741824

# errors
'{{ "1.15 GB" | human_to_bytes(isbits=true) }}'   # wants bits, got bytes
'{{ "1 gigggabyte" | human_to_bytes }}'           # invalid unit
```
